topic: Releasing dashboard updates and design changes
summary_markdown:
The team is preparing to release a new traffic calculation feature on the Mall Dashboard, originally scheduled for February 1st. The update includes both functional improvements (new traffic counting) and cosmetic changes designed to improve usability and visual clarity.

A discussion was held regarding whether these two elements should be released simultaneously under a single announcement or separated. It was decided that since the design changes are purely cosmetic and do not affect the underlying data, they should be launched together with the new calculation feature.
decisions: The new traffic counting feature and associated cosmetic/design updates will be released together.
action_items: Someone needs to provide specific points detailing what features are being released so that the release note can be written.
